name: tv-npf-contribution-reference
description: Conditional Tuvalu ordinary employed-member Provident Fund contribution reference using the 2022 Revised Edition. Covers gross earnings, separate employee and employer shares, nearest-ten-cent rounding and the employer's initial liability. Use for TNPF contribution and rounding questions. Requires the universal and social contributions workflow bases. Fictional monthly examples stipulate coverage, ordinary non-seafarer treatment and no overriding exception or direction. Complete current law, low-income deeming, actual deductions, voluntary additions, filing, remittance, income tax and other programmes remain held. This is a source-cited draft, not comprehensive jurisdiction acceptance or authority to operate payroll.
